\ubblockdescription{catalogue.cnn_window_scores}{Asks one of the researcher's trained CNNs how interesting each window looks: every window is resampled to 600 points, drawn as the picture the model learned on, and scored P(interesting) from 0 to 1; the score fills the window on the time axis. Follow it with Threshold to turn the confident windows into detections, and tune Threshold's threshold first. The models were trained on 600-sample, 10-minute windows of M2\_aug at 1 Hz: other window lengths are outside that scale, and M2\_aug's own scores are not out-of-sample. Windows holding NaN or flat are left out and counted.}
